title: Demonstration of home distribution board and safety precautions - Open day of UOP 2023
summary: The IEEE WIE Student Branch Affinity Group of UOP participated in Open Day 2023, showcasing home distribution boards and safety precautions. Attendees gained insights into efficient electrical management and learned how to ensure safety in residential settings.
